entity: Sunshine Senior Solutions and Almaz Med Supply: two mail-order suppliers taking most of Medicare's 2024 alginate wound-dressing spend
what_we_add: the alginate-specific share: $593,632,181 of $649,233,082 (91.4%), 494/359 dressings per claim vs 55 elsewhere
why: The Hilmi indictment names Sunshine Senior with $3.34B in false wound-dressing claims; CBS New York and BBB name Almaz billing for dressings never received. Both entities matched, same direction. No source has the 91.4% alginate concentration or the per-claim dressing counts.
